bulletins.title: Bank Fraud Department Spoofed Call
bulletins.summary: Scammers spoof the bank's phone number or follow up on a fake fraud text alert, claiming to be an investigator from the fraud department. They claim unauthorized charges were made and press the victim for verification details or full account balances under the guise of reversing charges.
phrases: calling from your bank fraud department
did you authorize this charge
cancel the card and reverse the charge
what is the balance of the account
make sure it has not been stolen
review a few other charges on your card
need to verify your account information

bulletins.title: FTC Impersonators Threaten Phone Number Deactivation
bulletins.summary: Scammers pose as FTC officials claiming your phone number was registered under criminal activity overseas and cite fake badge numbers. They threaten immediate line deactivation unless you cooperate with their demands.
phrases: calling to deactivate your phone number
registered under your name and number
used to commit scams
calling from the federal trade commission
threaten to deactivate your phone number
verify my badge id

bulletins.title: Take Five UK: Impersonation Scams Mimicking Police and Banks
bulletins.summary: Criminals impersonate police officers, banks, and trusted authorities during unsolicited phone calls. Scammers spend time researching personal details to convince victims to transfer funds or share sensitive account data.
phrases: calling from the police
fraud department of your bank
move your money to a safe account
investigating fraud on your account
verify your bank security details

bulletins.title: Fake Charity Sweepstakes Prize Calls
bulletins.summary: Impersonators call claiming you have won a major sweepstakes contest sponsored by a charity you previously supported. Victims are pushed to confirm banking details or pay processing fees to claim the bogus prize.
phrases: won a charity sponsored sweepstakes
sweepstakes contest you have supposedly won
claim your sweepstakes prize
pay fees to claim your prize
calling from a charity you support

bulletins.title: Misleading Open Enrollment Health Insurance Pitches
bulletins.summary: Callers capitalize on the health insurance open enrollment window by masquerading as government agencies or recognized insurers. They pitch non-compliant medical discount cards falsely framed as comprehensive health plans.
phrases: open enrollment health insurance
health insurance marketplace enrollment
comprehensive health insurance plan
medical discount card coverage
official marketplace enrollment center

gemini_context_snippet: Community reports this week: Bank Fraud Department Spoofed Call. Active phone campaigns involve FTC impersonators threatening immediate phone number deactivation over purported overseas scam registrations. Beware of open enrollment cold calls pitching medical discount cards as health insurance and charity sweepstakes calls demanding fees. UK callers also face heightened impersonation schemes mimicking police and bank fraud squads demanding transfers to safe accounts.
